about.manifesto.title: Scale Your BIM Execution Through Code, Not Headcount.
about.manifesto.lead: pyBIM provides practical BIM engineering services, multidisciplinary coordination, and model information review. We tailor engineering workflows to project requirements while drawing on specialized Revit, Python, and C# technical practices.
about.manifesto.rd_note: Alongside current delivery services, we are actively developing connected BIM automation and private AI infrastructure under internal engineering validation. Our workflows align with ISO 19650 information-management principles and incorporate UNI 11337 requirements where applicable to Italian projects, adapting to the agreed scope of each client and jurisdiction.
about.manifesto.aria_label: Engineering Evolution: From Project Delivery to Sovereign AI Infrastructure
about.manifesto.phase1_desc: Multidisciplinary BIM coordination, model information review, and project-specific technical workflows.
about.manifesto.phase2_desc: Revit-connected automation modules and repeatable workflow orchestration under technical validation.
about.manifesto.phase3_desc: Sovereign on-premises LLM inference and controlled engineering data reasoning architecture.
about.philosophy.title: Different Approaches. A Clearer Engineering Direction.
about.philosophy.subtitle: Engineering work can be approached through conventional delivery, standardized software, or an engineering-first model that gradually integrates purpose-built technology. pyBIM is building the latter.
about.philosophy.col1_primary: Conventional BIM delivery often relies on manual coordination, repeated data entry, and project-by-project review activities.
about.philosophy.col1_supporting: These methods remain valuable, but repetitive work and fragmented information exchanges can become more difficult to manage as project complexity increases.
about.philosophy.col2_primary: pyBIM focuses on practical BIM engineering, coordinated project information, and workflows shaped around real project requirements.
about.philosophy.col2_supporting: Alongside current engineering work, we are developing and testing connected automation, custom software capabilities, and private AI infrastructure for future use.
about.philosophy.col2_status_rd: Connected Automation & Private AI — Internal Development / R&D
about.philosophy.col2_status_note: New capabilities will be introduced following development and technical validation.
about.philosophy.col3_primary: Established BIM and software platforms provide useful capabilities through standardized features and predefined workflows.
about.philosophy.col3_supporting: For highly specific requirements, teams may still need additional integration, project-specific configuration, or engineering support.
about.journey.title: From Engineering Foundations to Intelligent Execution.
about.journey.subtitle: pyBIM began with hands-on BIM engineering and project coordination. Today, we are combining that experience with automation tools developed and tested internally. Our next objective is to make connected BIM automation available after technical validation, while continuing longer-term research into private AI infrastructure.
about.journey.p1_primary: pyBIM's engineering foundation is built on practical BIM project work, multidisciplinary model coordination, information management, and technical review.
about.journey.p1_supporting: Earlier workflows relied more heavily on manual coordination, repetitive model checks, and direct engineering intervention. This experience revealed where structured processes and internal automation could provide additional support.
about.journey.p1_focus: Practical BIM Delivery · Multidisciplinary Coordination · Engineering Review
about.journey.p2_primary: pyBIM is developing and testing connected automation and repeatable software-assisted workflows internally, using these tools where appropriate to support its ongoing engineering work.
about.journey.p2_supporting: The development phase remains incomplete. Internal validation and engineering feedback are guiding improvements before the company introduces more advanced automation capabilities for external use.
about.journey.p2_focus: Internal Validation · Connected Revit Workflows · Feedback-Guided Iteration
about.journey.p3_primary: The long-term pyBIM roadmap explores private AI infrastructure and controlled AI-assisted engineering environments, with future capabilities guided by practical project requirements and technical research.
about.journey.p3_supporting: This stage represents a direction under research and development rather than a completed commercial deployment, maintaining an engineer-in-the-loop review architecture.
about.journey.p3_focus: Exploratory R&D · Controlled Data Inference · Human-in-the-Loop Review
about.journey.beyond_desc: Future capabilities will be explored and introduced as they are developed, validated, and shaped by real engineering needs.

about.team.sec1.title: The People Behind pyBIM
about.team.sec1.desc: pyBIM brings together BIM engineering and software development. Our founders connect project requirements with practical digital tools and maintain clear technical responsibility across the delivery process.
about.team.sec1.footer: A focused founding team, with a delivery model designed to expand responsibly as project needs change.
about.team.scalable.title: A Focused Core. Flexible Delivery Capacity.
about.team.scalable.desc: Our founders lead technical planning, coordination and quality review. When a project requires additional capacity, pyBIM can organize project-based collaboration with suitable BIM or software specialists, subject to scope and availability. Responsibility for coordination and delivery remains clearly defined within the core team.
about.team.scalable.step1_desc: Defined technical responsibilities and project priorities.
about.team.scalable.step2_desc: Additional expertise planned around scope and availability.
about.team.scalable.step3_desc: Agreed reviews, communication and deliverable checks.
about.team.sec2.title: Infinite Scalability. Zero Overhead.
about.team.sec2.b_desc: Traditional AEC firms struggle to scale their workforce for massive infrastructure tenders without bloating internal payroll and management overhead.
about.team.sec2.a_desc: Rushing to hire unvetted freelancers compromises your proprietary data security and introduces fatal geometric errors into the final IFC models, risking public tender disqualification.
about.team.sec2.s_desc: We maintain a highly vetted, private network of specialized computational designers across Europe. We scale execution capacity instantly to meet project demands, with all external work strictly audited by our internal Python QA/QC scripts to guarantee 100% compliance with UNI 11337 and ISO 19650.
about.team.sec3.title: Backed by Academic Rigor. Trusted by Tier-1 Enterprise.
about.team.sec3.desc: Our architectural logic is rooted in continuous university-level research, while our execution infrastructure is authorized and deployed across major European AEC contractors.
about.team.sec3.l1_desc: Rooted in the engineering excellence of the University of Padua (Information Engineering) and Politecnico di Torino (Civil & Structural Engineering). We directly translate advanced computational research into autonomous workflows.
about.team.sec3.l2_desc: Native API integrations and certified developer access to Autodesk ecosystems (Revit, Navisworks) and headless OpenBIM protocols, ensuring total compliance with enterprise IT security standards.
about.team.sec2.network: The Extended Network: On-Demand BIM Coordinators & Parametric Modelers deployed exclusively through our automated validation pipelines.

about.team.sec3.cta_sub: (100% Free & Secure Data Handling. Bypass the sales team and speak directly with our core engineers to audit your current software workflow. No credit card required.)
about.team.sec4.title: Executed for Industry Leaders.
about.team.sec4.desc: Delivering algorithmic BIM solutions, automated QTO, and ISO-compliant databases for top-tier architecture studios and general contractors across the DACH region and Italy.
about.team.ecosystem.title: Strategic Ecosystem & Deployment.
about.team.ecosystem.subtitle: Operating at the intersection of strict algorithmic engineering and air-gapped enterprise BIM execution. We eliminate manual drafting bottlenecks.
about.team.ecosystem.manifest_desc: Direct translation of raw software engineering logic into deterministic, enterprise-grade AEC pipelines.
about.team.ecosystem.hub_desc: Operating from Northern Italy's premier technological center, our infrastructure is built on strict data architecture and computational logic, completely bypassing traditional manual drafting workflows.
about.team.ecosystem.api_desc: Direct programmatic execution within Revit and Navisworks APIs. We deploy air-gapped automation kernels to process heavy IFC4 schemas in seconds, eliminating manual interface friction.
about.team.ecosystem.v1_desc: Air-gapped hardware deployment for Tier-1 contractors. We guarantee absolute data sovereignty and eliminate network latency by executing complex geometric algorithms directly within your local LAN.
about.team.ecosystem.v2_desc: High-throughput, single-tenant virtual servers equipped with dedicated GPU acceleration. We instantly process massive clash resolutions without straining your internal IT hardware.
about.team.ecosystem.v3_desc: Automated validation kernels that strictly enforce ISO 19650-5 and UNI 11337 mandates. We mathematically verify your tender deliverables, eliminating the risk of human error and project disqualification.

about.tech.p2_desc: Extracting COBie and IFC datasets instantly via C# and Python pipelines.
about.tech.p3_desc: Validating EIR and BEP requirements natively without exposing data to public clouds.

about.impact.v2.title: Better Engineering Workflows. Greater Control.
about.impact.v2.subtitle: pyBIM combines engineering expertise, structured information management, and the selective use of technology to support more consistent and efficient BIM delivery.
about.impact.v2.outcome1.title: Less Repetitive Work
about.impact.v2.outcome1.desc: Structured processes and selective automation can reduce repetitive tasks, allowing engineers to focus on coordination, technical review, and project decisions.
about.impact.v2.outcome2.title: More Reliable Model Information
about.impact.v2.outcome2.desc: Defined information requirements and review procedures support clearer model data, identifiable discrepancies, and better-controlled BIM deliverables.
about.impact.v2.outcome3.title: Connected Multidisciplinary Delivery
about.impact.v2.outcome3.desc: Coordination across disciplines, software environments, and OpenBIM exchanges supports more organized collaboration and information handover.
